reddit.title: Introducing Materials Instead of Cost Badges!
reddit.body: We're excited to announce a significant update to how you manage resources in Provincia! No longer will build tiles obscure the multi-resource requirements behind a single cost chip. With our new Materials control, you can now see all the materials needed for your builds at a glance. For instance, when placing a bath, you can easily check if you have enough wood, planks, slabs, mortar, bricks, and tiles. Each material is displayed with stored vs required amounts, and shortages are highlighted for your convenience. Check out the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: Major Update: Materials Instead of Cost Badges
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce a major update for Provincia! The build tiles now feature a Materials control that displays all required resources for your constructions. This means no more guessing about what materials you need! You can see stored vs required amounts, and any shortages will be highlighted. This update aims to enhance your building experience and streamline resource management. For more details, visit: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
